records.issue_text: PriorityLevel(new_status) converts DetectorPriorityLevel to PriorityLevel by coincident int value; DetectorPriorityLevel includes OK and other values that may not map, so non-OK statuses can raise ValueError at evaluation time; mapping should be explicit

Duplicate-group-key safeguard removed from process_detectors, and evaluate keys results by result.group_key instead of the iterated group_key, so a handler returning a different group_key silently overwrites another group's result and drops its occurrence with no log

handler.evaluate now produces occurrences to Kafka before commit_state_updates(), but nothing in the diff calls commit_state_updates in process_detectors; if the caller doesn't commit, state never persists and the same group key re-emits an occurrence on every packet

No test covers the evaluate_group_key_value path where build_occurrence_and_event_data returns for MEDIUM/LOW status, nor the ValueError case from the enum conversion; build_mock_occurrence_and_event uses hard-coded id/event_id
records.rationale: The diff adds new logic in `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate_group_key_value` to call `self.build_occurrence_and_event_data(..., PriorityLevel(new_status))` for non-OK statuses. The updated tests exercise HIGH and OK paths, but do not cover other non-OK statuses (e.g., MEDIUM/LOW) or the potential `ValueError` from `PriorityLevel(new_status)` if the enum values don’t align.
